name: Si Stillinger-Weber (Stillinger-Weber 1985)
validity_notes: Original SW parameterisation for diamond-cubic Si: 2-body + 3-body angular term enforcing the 109.47 deg tetrahedral angle, fitted to a0 = 5.431 A and the cohesive energy. The canonical choice for frozen-phonon / thermal-diffuse-scattering multislice work on Si. Good phonons and elastic constants near 300 K; known to over-predict the melting point (~2500 K vs 1687 K) and it is not fitted to liquid/amorphous Si or to surface reconstructions.
citation: F. H. Stillinger, T. A. Weber, Phys. Rev. B 31, 5262 (1985). DOI:10.1103/PhysRevB.31.5262
